g1.flow: Same ayah, different first word. Al-Muʾminūn has a run of 'and it is He who' ayat (hearing and vision, this, then life and death), so it opens wa huwa. In Al-Mulk, 'Say' comes before it (67:23) and after (67:26), so it opens qul huwa. Hook: wa chain in Al-Muʾminūn, qul chain in Al-Mulk.

cues.23:79: In a chain of 'and it is He who': opens wa huwa, then life and death.
cues.67:24: After 'Say, it is He who produced you'; opens qul huwa, then 'when is this promise?'

g2.flow: Seven times, in surah order 10, 21, 27, 32, 34, 36, 67. Six say matā hādha l-waʿdu; As-Sajdah alone says l-fatḥu, and its next ayah answers with the Day of Conquest. Recall each by the ayah before: nations and messengers, man made of haste, grieve not, water to barren land, sent to all mankind, spend from provision, gathered to Him.

cues.10:48: After 'every nation has a messenger, judged in justice'; next, 'I possess no harm or benefit'.
cues.21:38: After man created of haste; next, the Fire they can't avert from faces and backs.
cues.27:71: After 'grieve not over them'; next, 'perhaps it is close behind you'.
cues.32:28: The odd one: l-fatḥu, not l-waʿdu. After water to barren land; next, the Day of Conquest.
cues.34:29: After 'sent to mankind as bringer of good tidings and warner'; next, an appointed Day.
cues.36:48: After 'spend from what Allāh provided' and their refusal to feed; next, they await one blast.
cues.67:25: After 'to Him you will be gathered'; next, 'the knowledge is only with Allāh'.
